test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
What would be the symbol on the opposite side of '*' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efa232df4fa84dddefcb27b2838b08f0f97e2797b299b684e9e53fb1ea7bf042.png]
solution:
From the given open dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34d0b729950e71f485f1a98395590e72ccdbf2012defe86483ca110b792d6a15.png] 

**} is the opposite side of ***

^ is the opposite side of #

& is the opposite side of @.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
